copied_snapshot.algorithm: SHA-256 of UTF-8 lines sorted by repository-relative path: lowercase file SHA-256, two spaces, path, LF; regular-file content only, not modes
copied_snapshot.reconstruction: Start with SHA-256 of every regular file in git archive base_commit; remove removed_files and overlay changed_or_added_files. Verified equal to the complete original raw receipt source_hashes.
